grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 13014 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the source carries no exact duplicate rows; airport_code has distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341, and their product (13023) closely tracks row_count, showing each row is one hourly observation at one of the three NYC airports. A derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniquely identifies each transaction-grain row, so no aggregation is needed and the zero duplicate rate confirms the identity tuple fully absorbs any repetition risk.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: The three-letter airport code (distinct_values EWR, JFK, LGA; null_rate 0.0) identifying which of the three NYC airports the observation was recorded at.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of the hourly observation (min 2013-01-01T06:00:00, max 2013-07-01T03:00:00, null_rate 0.0); samples land exactly on the hour, so this is the event-time column at hour grain.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: The local calendar date of the observation (distinct_count 181, range 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, null_rate 0.0), a date dimension derived alongside the UTC timestamp.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: The local hour-of-day of the observation (range 0 to 23, distinct_count 24, null_rate 0.0); this labels the time of day rather than measuring a quantity, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit per operator context (range 10.94 to 93.92, distinct_count 130, null_rate 0.0), a numeric measurement compared and averaged across observations.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (range -9.94 to 73.94, distinct_count 119, null_rate 0.0), a numeric weather measurement.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage (range 12.74 to 100.0, distinct_count 2178, null_rate 0.0), a continuous numeric measure of atmospheric moisture.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (range 0 to 360, distinct_count 37, null_rate 0.016828); nullable because the profile shows 219 missing readings, likely calm-wind periods, and the value labels a bearing rather than something summed or averaged.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour per operator context (range 0.0 to 1048.36058, distinct_count 36, null_rate 0.000154); nullable per the two missing readings in the profile, a numeric measure of wind intensity.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour (range 16.11092 to 62.14212, distinct_count 35, null_rate 0.745505); heavily nullable because gusts are only recorded when they occur, a numeric measure when present.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches (range 0.0 to 1.06, distinct_count 50, null_rate 0.0), a numeric accumulation measure for the observation hour.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars (range 983.8 to 1038.4, distinct_count 430, null_rate 0.114953); nullable because the profile shows roughly 11.5% of readings missing, a numeric measure of atmospheric pressure.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility distance in miles (distinct_values span 0.0 to 10.0, distinct_count 20, null_rate 0.0), a numeric measure of observed visual range.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: The full airport name joined from OurAirports per operator context (distinct_values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport; null_rate 0.0), a descriptive dimension of the airport.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: The municipality of the airport (distinct_values New York, Newark; null_rate 0.0), a geographic dimension from the airports join.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: The airport's elevation in feet (distinct_values 13, 18, 21; null_rate 0.0); a fixed attribute of the airport rather than an observation measurement, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The airport's longest runway length in feet (distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511; null_rate 0.0); a static airport attribute from the OurAirports join, treated as a labeling dimension rather than a per-observation measure.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: A pipeline capture timestamp with only three distinct values clustered within seconds (2026-09-02T23:26:11 to :13, null_rate 0.0), indicating a batch load time rather than the business event time, so it is mapped as a dimension and not as the time field.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), carrying the weather measurements for that airport-hour alongside static airport attributes from the OurAirports join.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, naming its grain, time column, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models from this contract.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by a validator and datacontract lint, reviewed and edited by a human, and only then consumed by the modeling engine to emit the gold fact and its dimensions; it is never executed directly.
limitations: The mapping does not filter, transform, or derive any column beyond the (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) identity used for the grain; it leaves to downstream consumers any decision about handling the high null rate on wind_gust_mph (0.745505), the moderate null rate on pressure_mb (0.114953), or how to treat missing wind_dir_degrees and wind_speed_mph readings, and it does not assess the completeness of the underlying airports/runways join beyond what the table's own contract declares.
